features: New incident type "Collected in a crash ahead" for high-speed pack accidents where the car ahead loses control, with the share based on how much time you had to react and whether you lifted or braked
improvements: Steward no longer captures the game screen: incidents are analyzed from telemetry only
Leagues can now see which Steward keys joined them
The league join window now shows the full data sharing terms
In a pack, a straight front impact is matched to the car directly ahead, not to a car alongside
Unsafe rejoin is only applied when the other car is clearly identified, was off track for at least half a second and came back before the contact
The spotter state used in the analysis is now taken at the exact moment of contact
Car numbers are now recorded for all nearby cars and candidates, making incidents easier to review
The main window now shows your iRating, with the license class under the Safety Rating gauge
The HUD history now shows your car number right after the lap, before the incident type
Clearer report wording when the car ahead loses control in the pack
When the other car cannot be confirmed, the inside-kerb rule also respects the 60% limit
The inside-kerb rule now applies only when the cars were really side by side
A car hit from behind while still ahead is no longer named the main contributor
Report numbers for peak braking are kept consistent across all sections
fixes: The session type is now identified even when the simulator takes a few seconds to publish it after a session change
Fixed incidents being reported as "insufficient data" after a session change, when the telemetry recording could stop until the app was restarted
Fixed the HUD not reading the license or analyzing incidents after switching to a different car or discipline without restarting the app
Fixed a window (such as Problems?) staying black on top of the app when its page fails to load; it now closes by itself, and Problems? opens your email app instead
Press Esc to close the Problems, League, Data and Update windows
Fixed joining a league asking to update Steward even with the data sharing terms accepted
